■ Stage Direction
SE: Whoosh
While seeing off the Trainer who just left.

...And so, we ended up picking out outfits that suited each other.
I found one piece after another that looked great on her, too—

Fufu! Looking back like that works too♪
I'm just glad you like that coordinated outfit.

They have special outdoor exhibitions right now,
so we can enjoy the art while taking a leisurely stroll along the promenade.

(I haven't used fragrances like this very often,
but somehow... it feels really nice...)

An intellectual space that's neither too stiff nor mundane, but still exciting...
It really is the perfect match for today's glamorous outfit.

Now that you're all dressed up, wouldn't you love to go somewhere that matches?
If you'd like, I can show you some of my recommended spots!

Simply put, it's "casual wear,"
so anywhere other than ceremonial occasions is totally fine! ...However.

Seeing her so excited was such a rare treat that I couldn't help but smile.
I would have gladly let her keep browsing as long as she wanted, but...

Oh! You don't need to treat me as thanks.
I brought you out today simply because I wanted to.
Ahaha! What in the world is that?

(It's so strange... A single new perfume, and the inspiration just won't stop.
Even though I didn't even pay attention to it until Trainer pointed it out.)

By the way, Trainer! What do you think of those cufflinks?
Between that one and that one, which do you prefer?

! I thought that was nice too.
It's sleek, and looks easy to use around the academy.

And now, a quick tip from Fuu-chan!
When browsing indoor exhibits, just be mindful of shoes that make noise♪

Which one? ...Wow, that's adorable!
The pattern alignment is gorgeous too... Everything from this brand is crafted with such care!

Soup curry, smørrebrød, a clubhouse sandwich...
Oh, which set dessert should I choose? Mmm~...!

Sometimes I come here alone to think, you know.
See, just like this... gazing back at my own reflection in the glass...

If you're in high heels, taking your time rather than rushing looks much more elegant.
That said, the most important thing is simply having fun without being overly stiff.

...You certainly have a novel sensibility.
Is it really that perfect?

Yes. The sound of water is so relaxing, isn't it...?
Looking at it like this almost makes me forget all the daily hustle and bustle.

—Wait, I'm so sorry!
I got completely carried away looking only at sunglasses...!

—First up is here♪ Art museums are
the perfect spot to visit on days when you're dressed up a bit stylishly.

On days you dress up, your polished self might just be a work of art too, don't you think?
With an open heart, let's go play in spaces of exquisite taste♪
(What is this flutter in my heart? Why is... Ah!)

Since she had picked out these clothes for me, I wanted to wear them out more.
Thinking that, I decided to ask her for advice honestly.

Oh, that skirt would go great with the tail scrunchie I bought today!
Or maybe that powder-blue dress would be nice too?

Oh, that looks like it would go wonderfully with the pants we saw earlier!
I'll try them on together later.
Ehehe... Mmm~... What should I do...?

Oh, are you sure? Fufu, it's such a lifesaver when there are two of us at times like this.
.

I couldn't explain it well, but it felt like a scent that suited her perfectly.
Smart, hardworking, faster than anyone, and radiantly shining.

Eep! T-Trainer?
Oh dear... Fufu, .

Shall we try the tester?
...Oh, wow♪ The top notes are green, huh.

Haa, what a sight...! Right, it's almost the season for them, isn't it.
Do you mind if I try some on?

So that was it...!
I understand completely, dressing for the right time and place can be quite a puzzle.

Huh? ...That perfume? It's an eau de toilette.
The bottle has such a simple, yet refined design.

A rare day off.
I decided to put on the stylish outfit North Flight had picked out for me before!

Or maybe something softer? A sheer, mature brown.
Exuding a relaxed vibe, like a sophisticated horse girl at a summer resort...

Daringly chunky in an all-cool black.
A bold look makes quite an impact! Hmm...

A head start on summer! Pure white makes a fantastic accent color!
With a subtly retro silhouette, it brings out a chic elegance within its freshness.

Ah, look at those! Those sunglasses look so cool♪
There are tons of other new eyewear designs too!

For lunch, let's head to my top recommendation of a café! Isn't the interior wonderful?
The menu has great variety too, and everything is delicious.

And so, North Flight quickly changed her clothes,
and we headed out together.

Looking at stylish clothes while wearing stylish clothes.
Window shopping is truly a classic!

I stepped outside hoping to go somewhere... but suddenly froze in my tracks.
Where on earth should someone even go in such fashionable clothes?

What caught my eye was a glass bottle as clear as the open sky.
Though delicate and seemingly weightless, its stylish presence was undeniable.

Hm hm hm~♪ Where's the perfume feature... Found it!
"A total ensemble that includes your scent," huh.

Next is the aquarium... That fantastical scenery is just brimming with atmosphere, isn't it?
Those beautiful creatures are packed with the "beauty" crafted by nature itself.
Mmm! Every single one is simply wonderful~...!!

Hats, belts, bags, even smartphone cases would be great.
Now, what would look nice on you, Trainer... let's see...

As for the other fragrance notes... Mhm mhm, this unexpectedly novel combination
really shows a playful touch. I can't wait to see how the scent evolves.
Yes. Ever since then, it's become quite an obsession of mine...

—It's a wonderful fragrance. Morning mist over a meadow, a forest breeze, lush mountain greenery,
and reaching upward toward the open sky... That was the image it painted.

Still, let's move on and look at the rest soon.
I'd love to help pick out something that makes you shine, Trainer!
I see. That must be it, for sure—!

—Oh, look at that outfit!
Are you heading out, Trainer?♪
